summary: Verified content import script + gallery feature end-to-end. Import script is fully idempotent (2 sequential runs both print 'Media baru=0 · dipakai ulang=47'; dry-run correct). 11/11 backend pytest cases pass covering DB counts, public destinations, public pages (home gallery/hero + page_hero for destinations/fleet/about/contact), image serving, and CMS round-trip preserving gallery items. Destination detail /destinations/bromo shows hero, dest-highlight-img 0..3 (4 images), dest-gallery with tiles, itinerary + FAQ; /destinations/pangandaran renders correctly with 4 gallery tiles; mobile 390px has no horizontal overflow (docScrollWidth == 390). CMS Halaman → Beranda page builder: pb-add-type dropdown lists 'Galeri Momen Tamu' and the existing gallery section card is present.
